items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: They just put it out after I put it out with Vinson, Eddie Vinson. ... had some saxophone players, Eddie Vinson and Gerald Wiggins.

ctx.x: They just put it out after I put it out with Vinson, Eddie Vinson.

Oh, I see. Well listen Helen, let's go back now to the time with the Basie Band. Well, you had done some traveling with the Band but you never probably had done anything just exactly like what was going on with that Band.
